purpose: The DESNZ sub-national domestic electricity and gas meter counts for every Great Britain local authority, 2024 (gas meters over electricity meters give the share of each authority's census households bound as gas-connected), and ONS's Labour Force Survey household totals for England, Wales, Scotland and the UK, 2024 (Great Britain's share of UK households, the interim share of the Energy Trends UK level the authority kWh rows are levelled to until Chronicle carries Northern Ireland's consumption, PolicyEngine/chronicle#356). Consumed by the local energy appliers (uk_runtime.domestic_energy_targets, microcosm#1207).
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.

Source: Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v.3.0 (Labour Force Survey household estimates; Families and households in the UK).
